method.parent_awards: Assume every disclosed outstanding RIL option converts one-for-one. Add 907,052 to the March31 issued13,532,472,634; include unvested options, assume no forfeiture, and credit no exercise proceeds. Zero additional parent option deduction means denominator treatment, not zero economic awards.
method.subsidiary_awards: Jio awards cannot be added as RIL shares. Value Jio ordinary equity at its disclosed March31 consolidated book equity excluding its lower-tier NCI; compute the incremental loss of RIL ownership if all Jio options convert. This is a historical carrying-value proxy with no exercise-proceeds credit, not an option-pricing or market-value estimate.
method.precision: Round to nearest INR1 million because book values are rounded and carrying equity is only a proxy.
method.nci_no_double_count: Keep prior aggregate NCI carrying deduction. Add only RIL incremental Jio dilution loss, not full Jio award value. E*(1-p)+E*p*A/(S+A) equals E*(S-H)/(S+A)+E*A/(S+A), where p=H/S. Existing outside owners also bear dilution; this identity keeps their economic share from being deducted twice.
method.expense_scope: Retain share-based employee cost in reported operating margin; do not add it back. Parent awards use denominator only; Jio incremental award claim uses employee_options_value only.
method.coverage: Covers the two material equity-settled award populations disclosed in RIL consolidated note28.2. It does not certify absence of every possible undisclosed/immaterial subsidiary claim.
